notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/formupload.md at cba512f. The evidence's Check and Browser measurements were taken on 2 October on 0.1.78-3795b4c; its 636f3f5 section (8 October, #188 fixed) replaces them where they differ (the remove control, the disabled opacity, the group and add-cell names), and the guide's Sources note was checked on that same build, so items citing it carry 0.1.78-636f3f5. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Its FormUpload.tsx and Additem.tsx still match every behaviour recorded here, read from source and token values, not run: the add cell renders only while maxCount is unset or attachments.length < maxCount, after the previews, and picked files beyond maxCount are dropped; with isInvalid an errorMessage replaces the support text, which resolves to rgb(245, 0, 48), while the cell background stays rgb(235, 235, 237); isDisabled sets 0.5 opacity on each cell only, never on the wrapper or label, and blocks add and remove; on the web the wrapper is role group named accessibilityLabel ?? label; the add cell is named “<label>, add attachment”; each preview is named after the attachment's name and its remove button, a sibling of the preview button, “Remove <name>”. No guide sentence is contradicted. One the guide leaves unclear: the Don't “Mark an error without a message” says nothing on screen changes, which holds for its example (no support text); with a support text and no errorMessage, isInvalid turns that support text red, so the content rule says so. Not recorded, because only the upstream Storybook text the evidence quotes says it and the guide does not: use FormField for typed values, and show the error as text, not colour alone. Not recorded: children (custom cells), name and Form errors, style and rowStyle, which the guide does not cover. Not recorded as gaps, per the pack's rules: #188, fixed on 636f3f5, and dark mode, which the evidence does not show. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every FormUpload, Card, VStack, Button and Text) and no other modes; the guide's docs-page wrappers (Surface and the width 100% VStack) and testIDs are left out. The In context example keeps the guide's Card, VStack, Receipts field and Submit claim Button, shown after a submit with no receipt; the guide's “Claim submitted” Text only renders after a submit with files, so it is left out. Copy is the guide's own; attachments are named Receipt 1 to 3, as the guide's are, with placeholder uris. The picker is a typed stub, async () => ({ assets: [] }), since picker must return a promise; a () => {} stub would not type-check.

examples.purpose: Claim an expense, the guide's In context: the field sits in a Card above Submit claim. Shown after people tapped Submit claim with no receipt, so the screen has set isInvalid and the message, and the button stays enabled. The empty attachments list, the onAttachmentsChange stub and the picker stub stand in for the app's own list of files and its own picker.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <FormUpload
      label="Receipts"
      maxCount={3}
      supportText="Up to 3 photos, JPG or PNG"
      attachments={[]}
      onAttachmentsChange={() => {}}
      picker={async () => ({ assets: [] })}
      isInvalid
      errorMessage="Add at least one receipt"
    />
    <Button label="Submit claim" onPress={() => {}} />
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: When people tap Submit without a receipt, the screen sets the error; the button stays enabled.

examples.purpose: Two receipts with a limit of three: each file shows as a preview with a remove button named after it (Remove Receipt 1), the add cell follows, and the support text gives the file rules. The uris are placeholders for the app's files, and the picker stub stands in for the app's picker.

evidenceFacts.name: attachments
evidenceFacts.description: Each attachment renders a preview cell (testID-item-N) that shows its uri as an image (cover), with a remove control; there is no file icon or name, so a non-image file has no thumbnail. File type and size are not checked.
evidenceFacts.quote: Previews render `uri` as an image (cover). There is no file icon or name, so non-image files have no thumbnail.

evidenceFacts.name: maxCount
evidenceFacts.description: One empty add cell (testID-add) follows the previews while attachments.length < maxCount, or always when maxCount is unset. Picked assets beyond maxCount are dropped.

evidenceFacts.name: errorMessage
evidenceFacts.description: Replaces supportText only while isInvalid (or a Form error) is set. Invalid changes nothing else: the cells keep their colours.
evidenceFacts.quote: `errorMessage` replaces `supportText` only while `isInvalid` (or a Form error) is set. Invalid changes nothing else: the cells keep their colours.

evidenceFacts.name: isInvalid
evidenceFacts.description: The support text turns red (rgb(245, 0, 48)) with a warning icon; the cells are unchanged.
evidenceFacts.quote: Error: support text turns red `rgb(245,0,48)` with a warning icon; cells unchanged.

evidenceFacts.name: isDisabled
evidenceFacts.description: Each cell renders at 0.5 opacity once, with the label at full opacity; adding and removing are blocked, and the cells leave the tab order.
evidenceFacts.quote: Disabled cells render at 0.5 opacity once, with the label at full opacity.

evidenceFacts.name: label
evidenceFacts.description: On the web it names the field, a group, and the add button, such as “Receipts, add attachment”.
evidenceFacts.quote: The field is a group named "Receipts", and the add button is named "Receipts, add attachment".

evidenceFacts.name: testID
evidenceFacts.description: Each preview gets testID-item-N, a wrapper holding the preview button and its remove button as siblings, and the add cell gets testID-add.
evidenceFacts.quote: `testID-item-N` now lands on a wrapper that holds the preview button and the remove button as siblings

gaps.text: Previews show images only: there is no file icon or name, so a non-image file, such as a PDF, has no thumbnail.
gaps.quote: There is no file icon or name, so non-image files have no thumbnail.

gaps.text: Figma has no error or disabled design: in the package an error only changes the support text, and disabled fades the cells to half opacity.

from.quote: Figma has no error or disabled design: an error only changes the support text, and disabled fades the cells to half opacity.

gaps.text: Figma's FormUpload puts its Add Item cells in one clipped row; the package wraps the row and always puts the add cell last.

from.quote: Figma’s FormUpload is a 328 × 93 component with label and support text options and a slot of Add Item cells in one clipped row; the package wraps the row and always puts the add cell last.
